lessons.title: Reflexive routines
lessons.objective: Reflexive routines: A reflexive pronoun changes with the person: me, te, se, nos, se.

words.es: Ana se ducha por la mañana.
Luis se acuesta a las diez.
words.en: Luis goes to bed at ten.

words.es: Sí, me despierto antes de las siete.
words.en: Yes, I wake up before seven.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una mañana normal with a patient classmate. Practice reflexive routines. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: This, that and those
lessons.objective: This, that and those: Demonstratives agree with the noun: este libro, esta mesa, estos libros, estas mesas.

words.es: Este libro es para la clase.
Esa mesa está cerca de la ventana.
words.en: That table is near the window.
I want this notebook, not that one.

lessons.title: Location prepositions
lessons.objective: Location prepositions: Use en for in/on/at as context requires.

words.es: La clase está en el segundo piso.
words.en: The classroom is on the second floor.

words.es: La biblioteca está cerca del café.
words.en: The library is near the café.

words.es: La tienda está lejos de la escuela.
words.en: The store is far from the school.

words.es: La mochila está debajo de la mesa.
words.en: The backpack is under the table.

words.es: Ana está delante de la puerta.
words.en: Ana is in front of the door.
